# Sketches of this repository that need a library in libraries.txt, one
# directory per line, relative to the repository root.
#
# compile_examples.sh leaves them out (it has no third-party libraries),
# and compile_third_party.sh builds them, for every board, against the
# libraries it installs. A failure fails the check: none is expected.
